sentences.text: Learned advocate for the applicant has submitted that considering the facts stated in the Application, the applicant may be granted anticipatory bail.
4. Learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondent - State has opposed grant of anticipatory bail looking to the nature and gravity of the offence.
He submitted that the present applicant had an intention to cheat the first informant from very inception.

The present applicant and the first informant were working in partnership and as a partnership, it was decided between the two that the first informant to purchase goods worth Rs.2,14,54,133/- and cost of the goods would be born by the two equally.

However, after purchase of the said goods, the present applicant had sold the goods in the market and had paid part amount to the first informant and remaining amount i.e. Rs.1,25,36,843/- is not paid.

Learned APP has therefore prayed that the present Application may NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/24304/2024 ORDER DATED:
11/12/2024 undefined be dismissed.

4.1. At the outset, it is required to be noted that earlier, the applicant had preferred Criminal Misc.
Application No.22265 of 2024 seeking anticipatory bail wherein this Court had passed the following order on 18.11.2024:-
"It is brought to the notice of this Court by learned APP that despite service of notice under Section 41 of the Cr.P.C. to the present applicant, he has chosen not to appear before the Investigating Officer.
In response to the same, learned advocate appearing for the applicant submits that the applicant shall report before the Investigating Officer on 22.11.2024.
If after recording the statement of the applicant, the Investigating Officer is desirous of arresting the applicant, 7 days notice shall be given to him prior to his arrest.

With the above observations, the present application is disposed of."
4.2.

Pursuant to the said order, the applicant had appeared before the Investigating Officer and thereafter, notice has been issued to him by the Police Sub Inspector, Khatodara Police Station,
Surat City, indicating him that he wants to arrest the present applicant and that is why, the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/24304/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/12/2024 undefined present application has been preferred by the present applicant.

5. Heard learned Advocates for the parties the arguments advanced by the learned advocates for the parties and perused the material available on record.
6.
From the record it appears that the dispute between the parties is in the nature of dispute with regard to partnership firm.
The present applicant and first informant were running business in partnership.

In the said partnership, the first informant had purchased the goods worth Rs.2,14,54,133/- and the present applicant had sold the goods in the market and had paid part amount to the first informant and remaining amount i.e. Rs.1,25,36,843/- has not paid to the first informant.

Having regard to the dispute involved in the offence and so also the fact that the present Dilipbhai Dharamshibhai Jethloja vs State Of Gujarat on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100560466/
2 applicant has co-operated with the investigation, this Court is inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant.
